issues.detail: The Hebrew lists three personal names: עֵיבָל (Ebal), אֲבִימָאֵל (Abimael), and שְׁבָא (Sheba). The Chinese renders עֵיבָל as '以巴路山' (Mount Ebal), adding '山' (mountain) which is not in the Hebrew and changes the name into a place, and שְׁבָא as '示巴人' (Sheba people), adding '人' (people) which is not in the Hebrew and changes the name into a people group. Both are personal names in the genealogy context, so these additions alter the meaning.
